metadata.name: AddAccountToLoyaltyRule
metadata.description: The Purpose of this API is to add referral in Referral account rule or to imposed any active loyalty rule on an account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of Card holder. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: Flag value to decide function of API. Valid Values: 0 = Referral Account Rule 1 = Target List Rule 2 = Update Referral Account Rule 3 = Update Target List Rule Example: 1

request_fields.name: UniqueID
request_fields.description: A unique value should be sent with every new referral. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: 987654311234567891 Condition: Required when 'DecisionFlag' would be 0 or 2. Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: RuleID
request_fields.description: ID of Loyalty Rule. Valid Values:Corecard will provide the ID. Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: Status
request_fields.description: A rule can be mark as Active or Inactive. Valid Values:0-Active, 1-Inactive Example:0 Condition: 1. In case of Decision Flag 2 and 3 only acceptable value is 1(Inactive). 2. Default and valid value for Decision Flag 0 and 1 is 0 (Active).

request_fields.name: StartDate
request_fields.description: Date when loyalty rule imposes on the Account. Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:12/11/2020 11:00:00 Condition: This field become mandatory for Decision Flag – 0 and 1 and will be optional for Decision Flag-2 and 3

request_fields.name: EndDate
request_fields.description: Date when loyalty rule will no longer be active for the Account. Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:12/11/2021 11:00:00 Condition: 1. This field become mandatory for Decision Flag – 0 and 1 and will be optional for Decision Flag-2 and 3 2. In case of update i.e Decision Flag – 2 and 3, EndDate can be updated to Current Date or future date, if EndDate is not crossed.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of Card holder. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded. Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: 200 Allowable Values: 15

children.name: ResponseTime
children.description: Time of API hit. Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:12/11/2020 11:00:00
